messages:
Maya (growth): Quick sync — we're aiming to launch the new Codelab Starter today at 10am PT. Need confirmation on: launch post copy, benchmark blurb, webinar link, and inbound lead routing.
Jon (devrel): Webinar is booked for Wed 11am PT. I'll host a 20min walkthrough + 10min Q&A. Can PR include benchmark headline? 2x latency improvement vs baseline.
Priya (content): Drafted blog intro + tweet thread. Want to A/B subject lines for the mailing list. Options: "Ship LLM features faster with our Codelab Starter" vs "Your fastest path from prototype to production".
Alex (design): Hero image and thumbnail done, pushing to Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. Thumbnails optimized for 16:9 and 1:1. Need approval on the CTAs.
Liam (sales): Inbound routing — please tag leads with source=codelab_starter and utm_campaign=codelab_launch. I can set up HubSpot flow if we give the webhook and field mapping.
Maya (growth): Priya + Jon, can you finalize the benchmark one-liner? We want something tight for social: "2x latency, 35% lower token cost on common chat workloads." Sound ok?
Jon (devrel): That reads well. We'll include a short methodology note in the blog: test harness + seq len 128 + 100 concurrent requests. I'll add a link to the repo with the tests.
Priya (content): Mailing list copy ready. Putting UTM examples here — please use these exact params:
```
https://redwood.ai/codelab?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=codelab_launch&utm_content=bench_2x
```
Maya (growth): @Liam can you set up the HubSpot mapping by EOD? Also need the webinar signup redirect to /codelab/webinar with utm params.
Liam (sales): On it — will add workflow and tag. Ping me if you want specific lead scoring rules.
Alex (design): One quick ask — can we keep the hero background motion subtle? bigger files slow page. I'll export a lightweight MP4 and a GIF fallback.
DeployBot: Reminder: scheduled release deploy queued for 10:00:00 PT. CI passed 6m ago.
Priya (content): I'll post the blog draft in #docs for review in 30m. Please leave comments inline.
Maya (growth): Awesome. If nobody objects, we'll publish at 10:05 and open the webinar signups. :rocket:
Jon (devrel): 👍 I'll post the tutorial repo link right after publish and start the webinar registration flow.
Maya (growth): Thanks team — quick, tight launch. Follow-ups in this thread.
